extension.summary: Otaku RPDev Multi-Provider Subtitle Service (Auto & Manual Search)
extension.description: Integrates Otaku RPDev's built-in 8-provider online subtitle engine (OpenSubtitles, SubDL, SubSource, Podnadpisi, BSPlayer, Addic7ed, Jimaku, AnimeTosho) into Kodi's OSD Subtitle Settings > Download Subtitle dialog with automatic match indicators, dedicated provider/engine settings, and full manual search.
